prefix.description: The character used to introduce escape sequences. Default is backslash.

intra_char.description: Character to insert between every output character.

intra_pause.description: Delay between writing each character. Formats: <num>ns, <num>us, <num>ms, <num>cs, <num>ds, <num>s, <num>m, <num>h, <num>d.

output_strings.description: List of strings to output. Supports escape sequences if interpret is true.

interpret.description: If true, interpret escape characters. If false, write literal strings.

output_target.description: Destination stream: stdout, stderr, or terminal.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the output. -1 for infinite.

sleep_delay.description: Time to sleep before processing. Formats: <num>ns, <num>us, <num>ms, etc.

exit_code.description: Exit status code for the process.
